name: Loa's Gathering
tooltip:
Loa's Gathering
Level 90
Item Effect
5 yd range
1 sec cast
Place a Loa's Gathering for all players to enjoy!

Restores 7% of your maximum health and mana every second over 20 sec. Must remain seated while eating.

Well Fed
If you spend at least 10 seconds eating, you will become Well Fed gaining (98 * 1.1) Stamina and (65 * 1.1) of your highest secondary stat for 1 hour.
